tasks.label: stat: list live stream names
tasks.command: $xml = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8080/stat -Method Get).Content; [xml]$doc = $xml; $app = $doc.rtmp.server.application | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'live' }; if ($null -eq $app) { 'no live app' } else { $names = @(); foreach ($s in @($app.live.stream)) { if ($s.name) { $names += [string]$s.name } }; $names | Sort-Object -Unique }

tasks.label: inspect: targets that point to ingest/live
tasks.command: $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $streams = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h http://localhost:8000/streams; foreach ($s in $streams) { $t = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $s.id) | Where-Object { $_.enabled -and ($_.rtmp_url -match '://(ingest|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.)' -and $_.rtmp_url -match '/live') }; foreach ($x in $t) { [PSCustomObject]@{ stream_id=$s.id; stream_key=$s.stream_key; target_id=$x.id; target_name=$x.name; rtmp_url=$x.rtmp_url } } } | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: inspect: targets that point to ingest/live (safe)
tasks.command: $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $rows = @(); $streams = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h http://localhost:8000/streams; foreach ($s in $streams) { $targets = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $s.id); foreach ($x in $targets) { if (-not $x.enabled) { continue }; $u = [string]$x.rtmp_url; if ($u -match '/live' -and $u -match '://(ingest|localhost|127\.0\.0\.1|192\.168\.)') { $rows += [PSCustomObject]@{ stream_id=$s.id; stream_key=$s.stream_key; target_id=$x.id; target_name=$x.name; rtmp_url=$u } } } }; if ($rows.Count -eq 0) { 'No enabled targets to ingest/live found' } else { $rows | Sort-Object stream_id,target_id | Format-Table -AutoSize }

tasks.label: diagnose current publisher + targets
tasks.command: $xml = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8080/stat -Method Get).Content; [xml]$doc = $xml; $app = $doc.rtmp.server.application | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'live' }; $names=@(); foreach ($s in @($app.live.stream)) { if ($s.name) { $names += [string]$s.name } }; $names = $names | Sort-Object -Unique; 'PUBLISHING:'; $names; if ($names.Count -eq 1) { $key=$names[0]; $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $resolved=Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/resolve?stream_key=$key"); 'RESOLVED_STREAM:'; $resolved | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; 'TARGETS:'; Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $resolved.id) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 }

tasks.label: repro: publish then start restreams
tasks.command: $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $s = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post http://localhost:8000/streams -Headers $h -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ name='repro-ingestdrop' } | ConvertTo-Json); $null = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $s.id) -Headers $h -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ name='echo'; rtmp_url='rtmp://ingest/out/echo-repro' } | ConvertTo-Json); $k=$s.stream_key; Write-Host ('StreamId=' + $s.id); Write-Host ('Key=' + $k); $pub = ("ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i 'testsrc=size=640x360:rate=30' -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=44100' -t 25 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -tune zerolatency -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -f flv rtmp://ingest/live/{0} >/tmp/pub.log 2>&1 &" -f $k); docker compose exec -T worker sh -lc $pub; Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Write-Host 'POST /start'; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/start" -f $s.id) -Headers $h | ConvertTo-Json; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Write-Host 'STAT STREAMS:'; $xml=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8080/stat).Content; [xml]$doc=$xml; $app=$doc.rtmp.server.application | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'live' }; foreach ($st in @($app.live.stream)) { if ($st.name) { [string]$st.name } }; Write-Host 'INGEST LOG TAIL:'; docker compose logs --tail=40 ingest; Write-Host 'WORKER LOG TAIL:'; docker compose logs --tail=60 worker

tasks.label: repro step1: create stream+target save file
tasks.command: $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $s = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post http://localhost:8000/streams -Headers $h -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ name='repro-ingestdrop' } | ConvertTo-Json); Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $s.id) -Headers $h -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ name='echo'; rtmp_url='rtmp://ingest/out/echo-repro' } | ConvertTo-Json) | Out-Null; $o = [PSCustomObject]@{ id=$s.id; stream_key=$s.stream_key }; $o | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 .\repro_stream.json; Get-Content .\repro_stream.json

tasks.label: repro step2: start background publisher
tasks.command: $o = Get-Content .\repro_stream.json | ConvertFrom-Json; $k=$o.stream_key; $cmd = "ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i 'testsrc=size=640x360:rate=30' -f lavfi -i 'sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=44100' -t 30 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -tune zerolatency -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -f flv rtmp://ingest/live/$k >/tmp/pub.log 2>&1 &"; docker compose exec -T worker sh -lc $cmd; 'publisher_started'

tasks.label: repro step2b: check publisher via /stat

tasks.command: $o = Get-Content .\repro_stream.json | ConvertFrom-Json; $k = [string]$o.stream_key; $url = 'rtmp://ingest/live/' + $k; Write-Host ('PUBLISH_URL=' + $url); docker compose exec -T worker ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -re -f lavfi -i "testsrc=size=640x360:rate=30" -f lavfi -i "sine=frequency=1000:sample_rate=44100" -t 30 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -tune zerolatency -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 128k -f flv $url

tasks.label: repro step3: resolve 'test' and start
tasks.command: $h=@{ Authorization='Bearer admin' }; $key='test'; $resolved=Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/resolve?stream_key=$key"); 'RESOLVED:'; $resolved | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; 'TARGETS:'; $targets = Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/targets" -f $resolved.id); $targets | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6; 'POST /start'; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Headers $h ("http://localhost:8000/streams/{0}/start" -f $resolved.id) | ConvertTo-Json; Start-Sleep 2; 'STAT AFTER:'; $xml=(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://localhost:8080/stat).Content; [xml]$doc=$xml; $app=$doc.rtmp.server.application | Where-Object { $_.name -eq 'live' }; foreach ($st in @($app.live.stream)) { if ($st.name) { [string]$st.name } }; 'INGEST TAIL:'; docker compose logs --tail=30 ingest
